playpause.note: Clean metallic button with crisp blue icon, fits the theme perfectly.

prev.note: Icon is legible, seating is nice with the blue halo.

repeat.note: Icon is clear, style matches row.

queue.note: Clear list icon, blue accent works well.

vol.note: Solid radial brush pattern, nice blue indicator. Tick marks could be slightly sharper.

seek.note: Track and fill are distinct, thumb interacts properly and casts a good shadow.

shuffle.note: Toggle thumb has a pause icon '||' which is confusing for a shuffle toggle.

visualizer.note: Glossy blue glass region, small comb-like detail at bottom is interesting.

album_art.note: Matches visualizer style perfectly, nice chrome bezel.

notes: The overall brushed silver look with blue glowing accents is highly successful and captures the Windows Media Player QuickSilver vibe.
Bevels and inset shadows give good dimensionality.
The shuffle toggle using a pause icon is the main flaw.
improve: Fix the icon on the shuffle toggle thumb to be blank, a dot, or a shuffle icon rather than a pause symbol.
Ensure the tick marks around the volume knob are slightly crisper.
